description: Phase 3D. Exercises the conjure-family phantom-pool activation lifecycle and the no-IP-leak privacy invariant. Day 1 enables the experimental-families gate so conjure routes are selectable. WAVE 5 CORRECTION: `conjure_compiled_in` is now constant false and `RecordConjureActivation` REFUSES a non-empty route ID, because gotapdance has never been in `core/go.mod` and conjure needs a cooperating ISP running a refraction station — a rented VPS cannot serve it. The activation steps below now record a refusal and `conjure_active_route` / `conjure_phantom_in_use` stay empty. The no-raw-phantom-IP invariant still holds, vacuously, and that is the correct reading: nothing is recorded, so nothing can leak. Retiring this scenario is rig-lane work. Day 7 the rig drives a second activation against a different phantom IP; the hash MUST differ from day 3's. Day 14 clears the conjure activation; diagnostics MUST clear `conjure_active_route` AND `conjure_phantom_in_use` to empty strings. Day 20 exercises the locked invariant: conjure IS opportunistic — auto-promotion MAY promote a network whose only family is conjure (this is the dual of psiphon-blob-rotation's day 14). The legacy subscription-url block layers so the distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
